# Icons in icons.js

The admin interface's 19 icons, taken once from the Iconify API and kept in `icons.js` (drawn inline, no request to
any server). Each set keeps its own licence:

| Set | Icons used | Licence | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Material Design Icons (Pictogrammers) | `mdi:` battery, fan | Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`) | https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign |
| Material Symbols (Google) | `material-symbols:` wifi, logout | Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`) | https://github.com/google/material-design-icons |
| Google Material Icons (Material Design Authors) | `ic:` power, restart | Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`) | https://github.com/material-icons/material-icons |
| Tabler Icons (Paweł Kuna) | `tabler:` brand-chrome | MIT (`LICENSE-Tabler-MIT.txt`) | https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons |
